heading: Contracts for transportation of mail by vessel
lead: The Postal Service may contract for the transportation of mail by vessel without advertising for bids.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2006—Pub. L. 109–438 struck out “for periods of not in excess of 4 years” before period at end.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective July 1, 1971, pursuant to Resolution No. 71–9 of the Board of Governors. See section 15(a) of Pub. L. 91–375, set out as a note preceding section 101 of this title.
